title: Who may run the iron
summary: Operator and driver rules that apply under any arrangement.

facts.claim: OSHA: only trained and authorized persons may operate an aerial lift. The employer is responsible for instructing employees in recognizing and avoiding unsafe conditions (29 CFR 1926.21(b)(2)).

source.name: OSHA — 29 CFR 1926.453 Aerial lifts, and Aerial Lifts fact sheet

facts.caveat: 1926 is the construction standard. Tree care may fall under general-industry rule 1910.67, not yet read.

facts.claim: In New York a single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 pounds or more requires a commercial driver license; Class B covers a single-unit truck.

source.name: NY DMV — Driver license class descriptions

facts.caveat: Check the GVWR on each truck's door sticker.
